summary_en: This phase 2/3 study tests whether a blood test that measures circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) can identify people who need more immunotherapy after surgery to remove the bladder, kidney, ureter, or urethra for muscle-invasive urothelial cancer. It also compares nivolumab alone with nivolumab plus relatlimab in some groups. Nivolumab is given by IV over 30 minutes on day 1 of each 28-day cycle, for up to 12 cycles, and relatlimab is given by IV in one arm. The record does not state a primary outcome measure; it is a phase 2/3 trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2/3 evalúa si una prueba de sangre que mide el ADN tumoral circulante (ctDNA) puede identificar a las personas que necesitan más inmunoterapia después de una cirugía para extirpar la vejiga, el riñón, el uréter o la uretra por cáncer urotelial de invasión muscular. También compara nivolumab solo con nivolumab más relatlimab en algunos grupos. El nivolumab se administra por vía intravenosa durante 30 minutos el día 1 de cada ciclo de 28 días, hasta 12 ciclos, y el relatlimab se administra por vía intravenosa en un brazo. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; es un estudio de fase 2/3.
who_for: Muscle-invasive urothelial cancer of the urethra, bladder, ureter, or renal pelvis treated with radical surgery.
Surgery done about 3 to 12 weeks (or up to 16 weeks, commercial test) before pre-registration.
Surgery pathology shows high-risk features, such as node-positive or advanced tumor stage.
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
Blood counts, kidney, and liver tests within the stated limits.
not_for: Partial cystectomy used as the definitive treatment.
Gross cancer at surgical margins, or residual cancer or metastasis after surgery.
Adjuvant systemic therapy or adjuvant radiation after surgery.
Prior LAG-3 blockade, or prior grade 3 or higher immune-related adverse event from PD-1 or PD-L1 blockade.
Current or past myocarditis, or active or recurring autoimmune disease; pregnancy or nursing.
